name: Adventurers: The Lost Tomb
author: karbin5555
description:
Help Johnny Thunder on his latest adventure! Navigate through the chambers of the Lost Tomb dodging deadly traps, collecting priceless artifacts, and solving ancient puzzles.

How to play:
- Move with WASD or arrow keys
- First collect all of the golden statues in a level
- Then find the map at the end of each level
- Complete all 7 levels
